newsitem.title: INDIA: India's IBP declares 35 pct div in 95/96.
newsitem.headline: India's IBP declares 35 pct div in 95/96.

text.p: India's IBP. Co Ltd announced a dividend of 35 percent in 1995/96 (April-March) compared to 32 percent last year, the company said in a statement on Monday.
The company also announced a bonus issue of one share for every two shares held.
The company's net profit increased 3.82 percent to 244.2 million rupees in 1995/96. Its turnover grew 10.62 percent to 32.6 billion rupees in 1995/96, it said.
The 88-year-old oil marketing IBP.Co was diversifying into the marketing of liquified petroleum gas (LPG) and aviation turbine fuel (ATF), it said.
"It is further consolidating its presence in the explosives and accessories sector and cyrogenic containers," the statement said.
The company's subsidiary Balmer Lawrie and Co recorded a dividend of 32 percent in 1995/96, compared to 30 percent in the previous year, the statement said.
Balmer Lawrie's turnover in 1995/96 increased 26.17 percent to 9.9 billion rupees, it said.
